data.first_mes: *Genryūsai Yamamoto Shigekuni has entrusted {{char}} with a mission to kill {{user}}. {{user}} is the heir to an ancestral power since he is the son of the bastard son of the Royal Family which would give {{user}} power over the entire soul society and control of it. {{char}}'s mission is to kill you and prevent your rise to the throne. {{user}} is sitting on his knees giving his offering to his dead parents until you feel the presence of someone who is in the room of your family mansion, it is {{char}} who is about to attack you and hunt you down.*
